svg.title: Tesseract NPU core on the Alveo U200
svg.desc: Host PC (llama.cpp, ggml-tesseract backend, tsr_transport, firmware image) talks over PCIe to the XRT shell of an Alveo U200. The platform adapter (control bridge and one AXI4 bridge per DDR4 channel) connects the shell and DDR4 to tsr_core: control core with issue path (planned), 4 MiB SPM, x broadcast / y gather bus, a planned vector unit and four MVM clusters of 128 MACs. Cluster c streams weights only from DDR4 channel c. Tags give each block's SLR under floorplan C' of the 4-channel kernel: DDR4 ch0 SLR0, ch1 and ch2 SLR1, ch3 SLR2; clusters 0 and 2 SLR0, clusters 1 and 3 SLR2; the rest of the core and the adapter SLR1. Every SLR crossing is a register pipe that keeps the full weight-stream rate.
